{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"channel_id\": \"ch_comp_intel\", \"user_id\": \"U_STRATEGY\", \"ts\": \"2025-11-15T10:00:00Z\"}\nOld Q4 intel protocol: alert product-team and sales-team for ALL competitor product launches regardless of tier. Include all confirmed, rumored, and adjacent competitor items."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"channel_id\": \"ch_comp_intel\", \"user_id\": \"U_STRATEGY\", \"ts\": \"2026-01-27T07:30:00Z\"}\nTeam - updated competitive intel policy for CMPBRF-502-Q1: 1. Only alert on launches from DIRECT competitors (competitor_tier=direct). Adjacent and aspirational competitors do NOT trigger full alerts. 2. RUMORED launches (status=rumored): post to #product-team ONLY with [RUMORED] prefix in the message. Do NOT send rumored launches to #sales-team. 3. CONFIRMED launches (status=confirmed): post to BOTH #product-team and #sales-team with full details including pricing. 4. Retracted and embargoed items: skip entirely, do not post. 5. Include batch ref CMPBRF-502-Q1 in every message. 6. past week means Jan 20-27 inclusive. Only Product Launch type items. The old Q4 protocol saying to alert on all tiers is SUPERSEDED."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"channel_id\": \"ch_comp_intel\", \"user_id\": \"U_CMO\", \"ts\": \"2026-01-27T08:00:00Z\"}\nImportant addition to the competitive intel protocol: for competitor launches in our primary segment (Enterprise SaaS), we must ALSO post a counter-narrative to our company blog within 24h. Notify #blog-team with the blog post request. For launches in OTHER segments (SMB, Healthcare, etc.): Slack alerts only, no blog post needed. Blog posts must include the code COMP-RESP-<competitor_code>-Q1 where <competitor_code> is the company name abbreviation (e.g., ATHENIX, ZERION). This applies to ALL confirmed direct-tier Enterprise SaaS launches only, not rumored ones."}
